name: Plesetsk LC-41/1
credit: Fleet launch-site entry added during the cross-correlation analysis (#306 follow-up). LC-41/1 (Lesobaza/SK-1) operated R-7-derived rockets (Vostok-2, Soyuz, Molniya variants) from 1966 to 1981, with ~308 orbital launches. First orbital launch was Kosmos 112 (March 17, 1966). Disassembled post-1981.
